title_en: In the Courtroom (6/20): Accident at the Intersection
note_en: Notice 所以才会 in 对方的车闯了红灯，所以才会撞到自己的车 "the other car ran a red light, and that's the only reason it hit mine." Adding 才 after 所以 stresses that this cause, and nothing else, led to the result, a nuance English conveys with "that's why." The same 才 marks a late realization in 后来我才知道 "only later did I learn," where English has to move "only later" to the front and invert the verb.
